name: Small Cat Action Fund
summary: Annual grants of up to US$15,000 a year for in-situ conservation and research on small wild cat species, favouring field work including equipment, transport and local field salaries.

steps: Full application and supporting documents, if asked

eligibility.rule: Does not request funds for conferences, scientific travel, legal actions, overhead or academic exchanges.
Applies to only one Panthera grant program per intake round
Project targets small cats, not the genera Panthera or Acinonyx or the puma
Project is for in situ conservation or research on small cats.

eligibility.quote: Panthera does not support conferences, travel to scientific meetings, legal actions, overhead costs, or academic exchanges.
Applicants are only permitted to apply to one Panthera grant program per intake round.
The SCAF supports work on the “small cats,” namely all species of the family Felidae excluding the genera Panthera, Acinonyx and the puma (Puma concolor).
The Small Cat Action Fund (SCAF) is a grants program established by Panthera and is intended to support in situ conservation and research activities on the many small cat species.
